name: Ikkakumon
main_effect:
[Security] At the end of the battle, play this card without paying the cost.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Trash the top 2 digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, 1 of their Digimon with no digivolution cards can't attack or block until their turn ends.
